title: Real-time: WebSockets, SSE, Socket.IO, reconexao e presence
description: Trilha sobre comunicacao real-time no browser: WebSocket nativo (API, readyState, eventos), Server-Sent Events (EventSource, reconexao automatica), Socket.IO (rooms, namespaces, fallback), reconexao e estado (exponential backoff, fila de mensagens offline, heartbeat), e presence e colaboracao (presence indicators, CRDTs, intro). Cobre o lado client; o lado server coberto em backend.

nodes.title: Real-time no browser: polling, long-polling, SSE, WebSocket
WebSockets nativo: readyState, eventos, mensagens binarias e texto
Server-Sent Events: EventSource, reconexao automatica, tipos de mensagem
Socket.IO: rooms, namespaces, fallback, ack, broadcast
Reconexao e estado: exponential backoff, heartbeat, fila offline
Presence e colaboracao: presence indicators, cursors, CRDTs (intro)
Projeto final: chat real-time com rooms, presence e sync de estado
